children: On October 4, Lookonchain reported that whale address "netherlol" bought 383.34 million PUMP tokens again after more than a year, according to BlockBeats On-chain Detection. The purchase was valued at about $2.4 million.
Seven hours earlier, a newly created wallet, GnZqfY, withdrew 189.22 million PUMP tokens from a CEX, or centralized exchange. The withdrawal was valued at about $1.18 million.

title: Whale Buys 383.34 Million PUMP After More Than a Year, New Wallet Withdraws 189.22 Million Tokens
